Posts to the local HTTP server and shows a card, exactly like a remote client would.
No token set. Generate one to require Authorization: Bearer on every request.
Bring the server up when the TV powers on.
Anything on your network can put a notification on this TV with a single HTTP request: a script, a shop system, a smart home hub, or the TibeePost web client.
This TV listens at %1$s. Write it down or leave the app open; it is shown on the settings screen too.
Cards are drawn over whatever is playing. Android only allows that after you grant the "display over other apps" permission, which is the next step.
Allow TibeePost to draw over other apps
Without this permission the server still answers requests, but no card can ever appear, so the app is unusable. Grant it now if you can.
Press Try system settings if the button is shown and toggle TibeePost on. If your TV has no such page, connect a computer with adb on the same network and run the command below.
This screen checks again every few seconds and moves on by itself once the permission is granted.
TibeePost can draw cards over other apps. Next, send yourself a test card.
This posts a notification to the server running on this TV, exactly like a remote client would. With the permission granted, a card appears over this screen for a few seconds and the chime plays.
The server accepted the request, but no card could be drawn because the overlay permission is missing.
Cards cannot be shown. The overlay permission is missing, so TibeePost is unusable until it is granted.
Setup finished, but TibeePost is not usable yet
The settings screen shows this address, lets you require a bearer token, and sets the default look, sound and duration for cards that do not specify their own.
Walk through the welcome, permission and test steps once more.
Notifications for this TV over HTTP
Point any HTTP client or the web sender at this address.
Scan the code with your phone to open the sender.
No IPv4 address. Connect the TV to Wi‑Fi or Ethernet.
Played when a notification does not choose its own sound.
Anyone on the network can post again.
Where to find it on this TV
Open Settings from the home screen (gear icon).
Choose Apps. On some TVs it sits under Device Preferences.
Choose Special app access. On some TVs it is called Security & restrictions or Advanced.
Select TibeePost and switch it on.
Enable Developer options and Network debugging on the TV, then run this from a computer on the same network:
Opened the permission page for TibeePost.
Opened the list of apps that can draw over others. Pick TibeePost there.
Opened the TibeePost app page. Look for Display over other apps or Permissions.
Opened the Apps list. Look for Special app access.
Opened Settings. Follow the numbered steps.
This TV has no settings page for it. Use the adb command.
The settings screen shows this address too, with a QR code for your phone.
